name: dynamic_same_target
domain:
(define (domain object-soft)
  (:requirements :adl :fluents :durative-actions :continuous-effects :preferences)
  (:types item) (:constants a b - item)
  (:predicates (done-reader) (done-writer))
  (:functions (pick) (other) - item (slot ?i - item) - item (clock) - number)
  (:durative-action reader :parameters () :duration (= ?duration 2)
    :condition (preference pref (at start (= (slot (pick)) a)))
    :effect (and (at start (and)) (at end (done-reader))
                 (increase (clock) (* #t 0))))
  (:action writer :parameters () :precondition (and)
    :effect (and (assign (slot (other)) b) (done-writer)))
)
problem:
(define (problem dynamic_same_target) (:domain object-soft)
  (:init (= (pick) a) (= (other) a) (= (slot a) a) (= (slot b) a) (= (clock) 0))
  (:goal (and (done-reader) (done-writer))) (:metric minimize (+ total-time (* 7 (is-violated pref)))))
